Lua 5.1.5 provenance for VOX
================================

Upstream project: Lua
Upstream version: 5.1.5
Upstream archive: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.1.5.tar.gz
Archive SHA-256: 2640fc56a795f29d28ef15e13c34a47e223960b0240e8cb0a82d9b0738695333
Imported: 2026-07-17
License: MIT/Expat; see COPYRIGHT in this directory.

This directory is an unmodified extraction of the official archive. VOX builds
the Lua core, parser, auxiliary library, base library, table library, string
library, and math library. VOX does not compile the standalone lua.c or luac.c
programs, nor the upstream io, os, package, or debug libraries. The VOX host
removes dynamic loading, bytecode dumping, process-global randomness, module
loading, environment mutation, and allocator control from the script globals.
Those restrictions live in engine/c89/vox_script.c; the upstream source remains
unchanged so its checksum and provenance stay auditable.
